headline: 部分作動薬が、AMPA受容体の開く前の中間状態をとらえた
subhead: 時間分解クライオ電顕でGluA2–γ2の4つの状態を解析し、ドメインの閉じ角約17°が分かれ道だと示した。

summary.question: AMPA受容体が開く前の中間体である前活性状態は、構造がよく分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: 部分作動薬またはGluを加えて素早く凍結する時間分解クライオ電顕で、GluA2–γ2の状態の集まりを調べた。
summary.result: リガンド結合ドメイン（LBD）の閉じが約17°を超えると開状態か脱感作状態に進み、それより小さいと前活性状態にとどまった。
summary.learned: 前活性状態のゲートは閉と開の中間の形をとるが、孔は閉じたままで、イオンと水は通さない。
summary.open: この方法では4つのサブコンダクタンス状態すべての構造は得られず、より速い時間分解クライオ電顕などが助けになるとされる。

question.quote: While the terminal apo, open and desensitized states have been structurally characterized, the intermediate pre-active state has remained an enigma.

approach.quote: Here we use different partial agonists and time-resolved cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) to capture a structural ensemble of GluA2–γ2 AMPAR complexes in the closed apo, pre-active, open and desensitized states.

result.quote: Binding of partial agonists to the ligand-binding domain (LBD) results in different extents of LBD clamshell closure, with closures exceeding a threshold of ~17° resulting in the open and desensitized states and smaller closures stabilizing the pre-active state.

learned.quote: The pre-active state has a distinct gate conformation intermediate between the other two discrete states, completely open and closed.
Despite these changes during pre-activation, the gate region remains narrow, keeping the pore sealed for conductance of water and ions.

open.quote: One limitation of our cryo-EM approach is that it does not reveal structures of all four subconductance states bound to full or partial agonists.
Faster time-resolved cryo-EM, experimentation with different agonist concentrations and larger structural datasets will likely help to describe iGluR gating in more detail.

highlights.text: 前活性状態ではLBDの上側（D1）の二量体界面が保たれたまま下側（D2）だけが離れる（S635間で24 Å、apoは17 Å）。前活性状態は、開状態と脱感作状態に分かれる分岐点にあたる。

evidence.quote: Because of the intact D1–D1 interfaces, pre-activation results in separation of the D2 lobes in each LBD dimer, measured as a distance between S635 Cα atoms (24 Å in GluA2–γ2KA-PreActive compared to 17 Å in GluA2–γ2Apo).
Pre-activation, therefore, represents an intermediate bifurcation point in the AMPAR gating pathway

highlights.text: 室温で作動薬を加えてから2.5秒以内に凍結した。KAは前活性状態だけ、IWは開状態だけ、NOWは3つの状態を示し、作動薬ごとに状態の分布が違った。

evidence.quote: with the time between the agonist application and plunging shorter than 2.5 s
IW favored only the open state and KA only the pre-active state. NOW revealed all three states

highlights.text: 単一チャネル記録では、どの部分作動薬でもGluと同様に4段階のコンダクタンスが見られた。MDでは前活性状態で水が通らず、開状態では孔に水が行き来した。

evidence.quote: Despite widely different probabilities of O1–O4, the measurable values of conductance for each of these states were strikingly similar between Glu and all partial agonists
Notably, the gate region remained largely dehydrated and no water conductance was observed during simulations of GluA2–γ2KA-PreActive and GluA2–γ2NOW-PreActive
In contrast, for all open-state structures, the pore remained continuously hydrated throughout the entire simulation trajectories

lab_notes.expression: BacMam 系で HEK 293 GnTI− 細胞に発現。
lab_notes.construct: ラット GluA2flip（Q586）とマウス γ2（L207 で切断）の融合体。C 末端にトロンビン切断部位、eGFP、Strep-II。
lab_notes.purification: 1% ジギトニンで可溶化し、ストレプトアビジン樹脂 → トロンビンでタグ除去 → Superose 6 Increase でサイズ排除。
lab_notes.sample_prep: UltrAuFoil R1.2/1.3 の 300 メッシュ金グリッド。部分作動薬 250 μM（Glu は 1 mM）を加えて 2.5 秒以内に自作の装置で凍結。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios（300 kV）、Gatan K3。cryoSPARC v4.4 で処理。

evidence.quote: The fusion construct GluA2–γ2 was prepared by introducing a GT linker between a modified rat GluA2flip subunit (UniProt P19491) with Q at the Q/R-site (Q586), which was previously called GluA2*20 and mouse γ2 C-terminally truncated after L207 (ref. 30).
The P1 and P2 virus were produced in Sf9 cells (Gibco, 12659017) and added to HEK 293 GnTI− cells (American Type Culture Collection, CRL-3022) at 37 °C and 7% CO2.
solubilized for 3 h in 150 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 and 1% digitonin
injection onto a Superose 6 Increase 10/300 GL size-exclusion chromatography column (Cytiva)
UltrAuFoil R 1.2/1.3, 300-mesh gold grids (EM Sciences) were used for sample preparation.
Immediately after agonist application, the sample was blotted for 1.5 s and plunge-frozen into liquid ethane within 2.5 s of partial agonist application.
Grids were imaged on a Titan Krios transmission EM instrument (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at 300 kV equipped with a Gatan K3 (Gatan) direct electron detection camera.
Data were processed using cryoSPARC v.4.4.

keywords: 時間分解クライオ電顕
editor_notes: 本論文は 10 個の構造（apo、KA、NOW、FW、IW、Glu 結合の各状態）を報告。記事の中心は KA の前活性状態（11VZ）で、ga_pdb_id に指定。著者自身が、ミセル中の TMD や気液界面の影響、人工膜での単一チャネル記録の限界を述べている。MD は定性的な補強と著者が書いている。
